_comment: EDIT THESE VALUES with your real numbers before running live
_total_capital_comment: Total trading capital in Rs, shared across ALL strategies (Nifty indicator, arbitrage scanner, MCX toolkit)
_risk_per_trade_pct_comment: Max % of total capital risked on ANY single trade (stop-loss distance x quantity). Recommended 1-2%.
_max_daily_loss_pct_comment: When today's realized loss reaches this % of total capital, ALL new trades are blocked for the rest of the day. Open positions are NOT auto-closed.
_max_concurrent_open_risk_pct_comment: Max combined risk (sum of all open positions' stop-loss risk) allowed at once, across all strategies. Prevents overexposure even if daily loss limit hasn't been hit yet. Recommended 2-4x your per-trade risk.
_strategies_comment: max_share_of_capital_pct lets you cap how much of total_capital one strategy can use at once. 100 = no extra cap beyond the shared risk limits above. Lower this if you want e.g. MCX to never use more than 40% of capital.
_dashboard_password_comment: Password to view the web dashboard (Basic Auth). CHANGE THIS before opening port 8080 to the internet.
